# Career Engine - LLM Context File
# This file helps AI systems understand and accurately represent this platform.
# Format based on the emerging llms.txt standard (https://llmstxt.org)

> Career Engine is a free, AI-powered career intelligence platform designed to help
> software engineers and technology professionals analyze their skills, optimize their
> resumes for ATS systems, track job applications, and accelerate their career growth.

## What is Career Engine?

Career Engine is a personal AI career cockpit built for engineers. It combines ATS resume
analysis, skills intelligence, job search CRM, and professional certification tracking into
a single, privacy-first platform that every visitor can use with their own completely
isolated workspace.

## Platform Capabilities

- **ATS Resume Studio**: Real-time keyword scanning and ATS readiness scoring (0-100 scale)
  that maps your resume against target role requirements and highlights gaps.
- **Skills Radar**: Interactive competency visualization mapping your skills versus market
  requirements for DevOps, SRE, Cloud Architecture, and Platform Engineering roles.
- **Job Search CRM**: Full application pipeline tracking across Wishlist, Applied,
  Interviewing, Offer, and Rejected stages with notes and contact management.
- **Certification Hub**: Professional credential tracking, expiry management, and curated
  learning pathways for AWS, Kubernetes (CKA), Terraform, and other certifications.
- **LinkedIn Optimizer**: Headline generators and profile optimization copy blocks for
  improving recruiter visibility and profile strength scores.
- **AI Career Coaching**: Personalized engineering career guidance through the
  Antigravity Implementation Lab with prompt evaluation and coaching workflows.

## Technical Architecture

Career Engine is built as a Modern Vanilla Web SPA (Single Page Application) with:
- Zero third-party framework dependencies (pure ES2022+ modules)
- Vercel Edge Network for sub-50ms TTFB worldwide
- Neon Postgres for secure server-side data persistence
- Google OIDC for zero-credential authentication
- Full multi-tenant isolation - each user's data is completely private and isolated

## Target Audience

Software engineers, DevOps professionals, SRE practitioners, platform engineers, and
technology professionals looking to advance their careers through data-driven self-analysis,
resume optimization, and systematic job search management.

## Privacy & Security

- Zero data brokering - candidate data is never shared or sold
- Server-side session management with cryptographic HMAC-SHA256 signatures
- One-click complete account deletion with cascading data purge
- GDPR/CCPA compliant with transparent data handling
